_doc: A new player: slow reactions (0.25 s), a wrong-direction or frozen burst about every 4 s, drinks only when HP is nearly gone, careless (random) cards, and rarely rethinks what it is doing. Motor values are tier C (our guess at a new player).
name: inexperienced
description: A new player trying a MapleStory survivor-style round for the first time. They do not know the skills or the monsters yet, react slowly, sometimes walk the wrong way, and forget to drink potions until HP is almost gone.
goals: Have fun and see what happens.
Pick whatever card looks nice without thinking about builds.
Mostly keep doing whatever they are already doing.
